$comment: Starter data loaded into an EMPTY database on first start. Swap this file (or point SEED_FILE at another one) for a different business. Prices are in the currency set in business.config.ts. "stock" is optional: leave it out for items you never run out of, or give a number and the shop will refuse orders beyond it.

reviews.quote: The sourdough is the kind of bread you plan your whole breakfast around. Perfect crust, every time.
Those croissants arrived still warm. They have officially ruined supermarket pastries for me.
The chocolate cake was the star of our celebration. Rich, elegant, and not too sweet.

content.label: Announcement bar
content.value: Free delivery on orders over $35 · baked fresh every morning

content.label: Hero subtitle
content.value: Small-batch breads, golden pastries, and treats worth lingering over. Delivered warm-ish across the neighborhood.

content.label: Our story
content.value: We began with one stubborn sourdough starter, a secondhand oven, and a belief that good bread makes a day feel more possible. We still mix, shape, and bake every batch by hand in our little Juba kitchen.
